caption_L1: Real Gross Domestic Product (GDP) of the federal state of Illinois from 2000 to 2019 (in billion U.S. dollars) is a line plot. The x-axis measures Year while the y-axis plots Real GDP in billion U.S. dollars.
caption_L2L3: There is a steady increase in GDP between 2000 and 2019 from approx 650 billion to 800 billion dollars. There is a slight jump in approx 2007 and fall in approx 2009 but this is less than 50 billion dollars and continues rising after.
